messages:
alex: quick flag — user on Vercel Edge reported our TS types collapse after bundling, generics become any and overload resolution is wrong

maggie: seen this in a couple of examples. often an esbuild/vite transform + dual ESM/CJS typings mismatch. repro?

alex: minimal tsconfig from the failing sample:
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "es2020",
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "skipLibCheck": false,
    "strict": true
  }
}
```
consuming code like `const out = await client.call<Input, Output>(...)` ends up with Output inferred as `any` after the edge build.

toni: those compiler flags + bundler mode are a brittle combo. bundlers rewrite imports so tsc's d.ts resolution can point at the wrong file (cjs vs esm). also isolatedModules prevents some emit details.

maggie: two core issues: (1) our package.json currently exposes ESM/CJS with a single shared types file (dist/index.d.ts) — TS can pick the wrong one depending on resolution; (2) some overloads fall back to non-generic signatures because inference can't see the ESM-only d.ts shape.\n
sam: also a runtime note: edge platforms (Vercel/Bun) have ephemeral sockets and platform-level retries, so our automatic retry-on-401 strategy is dangerous there — users saw duplicate side-effects because both platform and SDK retried.

alex: current package.json snippet:
```json
"main": "dist/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "dist/index.cjs"
  }
}
```

toni: straightforward improvements: emit separate declaration files for ESM and CJS, then point TS to the ESM d.ts for `import` resolution via `typesVersions` or conditional exports. and stop relying on `declaration` during the transpile step for bundlers; use `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` as a separate job targeting the ESM layout.

maggie: also set `skipLibCheck: true` in the published tsconfig to reduce downstream noise (we keep strict while developing). and audit exported overloads so generic-first patterns win.

alex: prototype `typesVersions` mapping I tried:
```json
"typesVersions": {
  "*": {
    "import": ["dist/esm/index.d.ts"],
    "require": ["dist/index.d.ts"]
  }
}
```
this forces TS to prefer the ESM d.ts for import-style resolution which aligns with edge bundlers.

toni: good. for overloads, avoid `Promise<any>` fallbacks. i found a fragile pattern we have:
```ts
function run(opts: Req): Promise<any>
function run<T>(opts: Req & { parseAs: T }): Promise<T>
```
TS sometimes matches the first signature. prefer the generic-first signature and consider a discriminant like `parseAs: "json" | "raw"` so inference is deterministic.

sam: runtime change proposal: add option `retryMode: 'node' | 'edge' | 'none'` defaulting to `node` for server, `edge` should be opt-in with safe semantics (no 401 auto-retry). document the reason in edge README.

alex: build changes i will land in a quick PR:
- add `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationDir dist/esm/types` step for ESM types
- keep CJS d.ts at `dist/index.d.ts` for legacy require consumers
- add `typesVersions` and exports conditionals to package.json
- flip fragile overloads to generic-first and remove bare `any` fallbacks
- publish a sample `tsconfig.published.json` with `skipLibCheck: true` and guidance

maggie: add a CI matrix job: install package in a fresh repro, run `tsc --noEmit` for both Node and Edge sample apps (Vite + esbuild) to catch regressions. also run `tsserver` via language server smoke test if possible.

toni: i'll open a spec doc for the overload refactors — we should standardize patterns (generic-first, discriminated opts, no `any` fallback).

sam: i'll take the retry behavior change and add tests simulating platform retries to ensure no double-submit semantics.

ci-bot: created issue #345 "dts parity + edge typing + retry semantics" and assigned alex, sam, maggie, toni.

alex: thanks — i'll push the PR for declarations + package.json tweaks and link to #345. leaving a note in the sample app README recommending `moduleResolution: "bundler"` and explaining why we publish ESM-specific d.ts.

maggie: nice. follow-up tasks: (1) PR for declarations and typesVersions, (2) runtime retry opt-in for edge, (3) CI sample coverage, (4) overload audit. i'll track in the sprint. :thumbsup:
